headline: Libya Plans New Oil Bidding Rounds for 2027 and 2028 Despite Security Risks
summary: Libya has scheduled a bidding round for undeveloped oil fields in 2027 and another for exploration in 2028 to increase production amid unstable security.
why: Libya holds some of Africa's largest proven crude oil reserves, and changes in its production capacity or licensing rounds can affect global energy supplies.

impacts.name: Crude oil
impacts.why: Plans to ramp up oil production through new bidding rounds directly involve crude oil supply prospects.
